subject: Agriculture
title: Climate-Resilient Crops
description: A short lesson to help you apply Climate-Resilient Crops.

hook.text: Green Revolution varieties were bred for ideal conditions. Climate change creates anything but ideal.

buildup.text: Droughts, floods, and heat waves are increasing. Crops bred for stable weather fail when conditions shift.

discovery.text: Breeders are developing 'scuba rice' that survives two weeks underwater and drought-tolerant maize for Africa.

twist.text: Climate change moves faster than traditional breeding. New varieties may be obsolete before they're deployed.

climax.text: Gene editing tools like CRISPR could accelerate breeding from decades to years—if regulations allow it.

punchline.text: The next revolution must outrun the climate. Speed is everything.

quiz.question: What is 'scuba rice' designed to survive?
options: Two weeks of complete submersion underwater
